tasks.short: Evaluate inspection findings and advise on regulatory action.

steps.what: Find inspection evidence and applicable provisions in the case repository
Evaluate evidence, significance, uncertainty and appropriate regulatory response
Write technical advice stating findings, reasoning and limits
Check final advice, references, qualifications and intended case recipient
Save the checked final advice to the case
Send the checked final advice to the designated case colleague

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} case views, provision links and advice headings. The scientist evaluates the actual evidence and writes the reasoning; templates reduce repeated layout and case details, with ordinary final checking before each save or send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct evidence revision and repeating case details.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata views and document fields.
tasks.still_hard: Evidence sufficiency and proportionate action in a disputed case.
tasks.human_edge: Explain scientific uncertainty and recommend defensible action.
tasks.altitude: Less case retrieval and repeated formatting; regulatory authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: repository metadata views and document fields can reduce case retrieval and repeated advice formatting without determining regulatory action.

assumptions: Boundary is scientist evaluation and technical advice through internal handoff, not prosecution or issuing an order. Inspection staff produce case identifier, location, date, observed condition, measurements, revision and evidence references; the legal owner supplies current provisions. Scientist retrieves and validates them in s1; missing metadata is manually checked there, not inferred.

Native first; existing views or templates yield zero new saving. Provisional shares include actual written advice, not invented administration. Normal final advice checking is s4, no extra approval ceremony. Save1 and send1 fully retained; external recipients require act_external and the same final-version gate.
unknowns: Case metadata quality and current native views
research_questions: Which repeated advice fields can be linked without inserting legal conclusions?

tasks.short: Validate environmental data and interpret scientific significance.

steps.what: Retrieve laboratory and monitoring results and reconcile identifiers, units and provenance
Calculate descriptive summaries and plot specified comparisons in analysis software
Evaluate validity, confounding, uncertainty and scientific meaning of observed relationships
Record the actual analysis methods, findings and scientific qualifications
Save the final analysis record

tasks.design: Configure native laboratory import mappings and saved analysis recipes in {OTHER} analysis software. Automate only repeated descriptive calculations and plots; the scientist checks source quality and determines scientific meaning and limitations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated result reconciliation and plot construction.
tasks.enabler_now: Native instrument exports, unit mappings and saved analysis recipes.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing association, sampling artefacts and plausible environmental effects.
tasks.human_edge: Judge validity and explain competing interpretations.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated data preparation; scientific interpretation remains the scientist's decision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: laboratory imports and saved statistical recipes can repeat data preparation and descriptive plots while scientific validity and causation require expert judgement.

assumptions: Boundary starts with actual laboratory and monitoring results and ends at the scientist's analysis record. Laboratory and monitoring producers provide sample ID, location, timestamp, analyte, value, unit, method, detection limit and quality flag. Scientist reconciles missing or inconsistent fields manually in s1. Scientist selects comparisons within s1 before s2; no free model-selected hypothesis.

Native first. Provisional s2 describes human repetition of an established analysis recipe, not existing computer runtime; where recipes already run no new saving. Source collection, scientific review45 and actual record writing14 remain. Shares unmeasured; save1 fully retained.
unknowns: Result export coverage and current saved recipes
research_questions: Which plots are repeated manually on comparable result batches?

incremental.description: Validate import mappings and descriptive recipe revisions

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final checked analysis record

tasks.short: Investigate environmental accidents and report findings.

steps.what: Inspect the accident scene and collect actual environmental observations
Record field findings and assemble available sample results and incident chronology
Determine likely causes, environmental effects, uncertainties and recommended responses
Draft the accident report from actual evidence and scientist conclusions

loop.input: referenced evidence pack and scientist conclusions
loop.output: draft accident report with references and unknowns
loop.check: Scientist checks chronology, causal qualifications, omitted contrary evidence and every factual assertion against sources
loop.stop: Missing sources or two failed revisions return drafting to the scientist
loop.why_not_simpler: Native headings first; variable incident narratives need prose beyond fixed fields

steps.what: Check the complete final report and intended internal incident recipient
outputs: checked final accident report and recipient

steps.what: Save the checked final accident report
inputs: checked final accident report and recipient

steps.what: Send the checked final accident report to the incident lead
inputs: checked final accident report and recipient

tasks.design: Keep actual investigation, evidence capture and cause assessment human. After testing native {DOCS} templates, use a bounded draft loop over the captured evidence and scientist conclusions; ordinary complete-report checking precedes separate save and internal send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing coherent incident accounts without losing uncertainty or chronology.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting from an explicit evidence pack.
tasks.still_hard: Access to the scene, causal attribution and incomplete evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Investigate conflicting accounts and qualify environmental conclusions.
tasks.altitude: Less report composition; investigation and response authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded drafting can restate a supplied incident chronology and expert conclusions, subject to source and meaning checks; it cannot establish accident causes.

assumptions: Boundary is investigation through internal reporting, not emergency response execution or statutory filing. Scientist collects and captures location, time, observations, sample references and uncertainties in s1/s2. Incident staff produce actual event logs and laboratory staff actual results; missing evidence stays unknown, with manual composition fallback. No free structured chronology is presumed.

Native first. Provisional report14 includes existing composition only; scene35, capture15, conclusions25 and final QA9 unchanged. Save1 and send1 retained. Ordinary final report review s5 binds exact version; edits require rechecking. Shares not measured.
unknowns: Report composition share and evidence access restrictions
research_questions: Can drafts preserve unresolved contradictions without inventing causes?

tasks.short: Develop technical sections of legal documents and orders.

steps.what: Read legal drafting instructions and retrieve referenced scientific evidence
Select defensible technical assertions, limits and proposed measurable conditions
Draft technical sections using selected assertions and source references

loop.purpose: Compose technical sections without deciding legal effect
loop.input: verified technical drafting pack and scientist selected content
loop.output: draft sections with source references and explicit limits
loop.check: Scientist checks technical meaning, units, evidence support, omitted qualifications and unintended obligations
loop.stop: Missing evidence, changed substantive conditions or two failed checks require manual drafting
loop.why_not_simpler: Native clause and heading templates first; variable technical explanations need bounded prose

steps.what: Check the complete final technical contribution and designated legal colleague
outputs: checked final technical contribution and recipient

steps.what: Save the checked final technical contribution
inputs: checked final technical contribution and recipient

steps.what: Send the checked final technical contribution to the legal colleague
inputs: checked final technical contribution and recipient

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} sections and source links first, then bounded prose drafting from the scientist-selected technical content. The scientist checks the final contribution before save and internal handoff; legal colleagues retain legal formulation, authority and issuance of any order.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeating technical explanations while preserving evidential qualifications.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting with explicit technical limits.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific defensibility and the legal implications of technical wording.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish established facts, inference and proposed conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less composition time; no new authority to issue legal instruments.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded prose drafting can restate supplied technical evidence and conclusions while expert checking and legal issuance remain human responsibilities.

assumptions: Boundary is scientist technical drafting through internal legal handoff. Legal colleague supplies document purpose, requested sections, current version and recipient; scientific evidence producers supply actual methods, results, units and source identifiers. Scientist verifies all material in s1 and selects content in s2; missing evidence requires manual resolution, never fabricated assertions.

Native templates first; existing configuration earns zero new saving. Shares provisional, not measured. Draft review in s3 and normal complete contribution QA in s4 are distinct existing composition and final-check work, not an extra self-approval ritual. Saves/sends1 each fully retained; legal review and issuance outside this scientist task have no claimed saving.
unknowns: Actual composition share and permitted confidential evidence handling
research_questions: Do drafts preserve limits without adding technical commitments?
